title: Reduction of a specified principal quotient Milnor triangle morphism
statement: Let J be an essentially small site, R a commutative ring, r a nonzerodivisor, I=(r), and K,Y objects of the unbounded derived category of sheaves of R-modules. Let F be the constant tower at K and G the principal derived quotient tower K tensor^L R/I^n, with canonical augmentation a:F->G [lem-sfb-source-reduced-koszul-successor-lifts]. Let PK and PG be limiting product fans [def-sfb-source-principal-reduction-product]. Suppose distinguished Milnor triangles at K and Y for these fans are given; the first arrow of the constant triangle is the diagonal identity lift. If u:K->Y and the product map m induced by a satisfy both triangle squares cK m = u cY and deltaK u[1] = m deltaY [lem-sfb-source-milnor-proisomorphism-invertibility], then reductionModIdeal(J,I)(u) is an isomorphism. No ordinary quotient presentation, torsion-free representative, derived-limit functor, coefficient equivalence, or normalization-existence assertion is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Tensor both limiting product fans with the first principal quotient. The source isLimit_fan_whiskerRight_quot proves these are limiting. Product extensionality, applied after each projection, identifies the images of both tower-shift endomorphisms with the new shifts and identifies the mapped product-tower map. The triangulated structure of tensoring therefore gives distinguished reduced Milnor triangles.

Choose the backward successor lifts of exists_lift_whiskerRight_derivedCompletionCone with the given nonzerodivisor and principal ideal. They give both composite identities for the reduced augmentation. Apply isIso_of_proIso to the two reduced triangles. The first square is the image of cK m = u cY. For the last square, use naturality of the tensor functor commShiftIso to move the shift comparison past the shifted image of u, then map deltaK u[1] = m deltaY. This proves the image of this specific u invertible.

The canonical module isomorphism R/I^1 -> R/I induced by pow_one gives, under constantSheaf and singleFunctor, an isomorphism of coefficient objects. Applying the right-tensor functor gives an isomorphism between tensoring by the first quotient and reductionModIdeal. Its naturality expresses reductionModIdeal(u) as a composite of the just-proved isomorphism and the two coefficient-comparison components.

theorem isIso_reductionModIdeal_of_principalMilnorMorphism
    {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {R : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R]
    {I : Ideal R} {r : R} (hr : r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) (hI : I = Ideal.span {r})
    (K Y : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))) (u : K ⟶ Y)
    (PK : Fan fun _ : ℕ ↦ K) (hPK : IsLimit PK)
    (PG : Fan fun n : ℕ ↦ (DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionDiagram J I K).obj (op n))
    (hPG : IsLimit PG)
    (δK : PK.pt ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (cY : Y ⟶ PG.pt) (δY : PG.pt ⟶ Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hTK : Triangle.mk (Fan.IsLimit.lift hPK (fun _ ↦ 𝟙 K))
      (𝟙 PK.pt - towerShift (F := (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj K) hPK) δK ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))))
    (hTY : Triangle.mk cY
      (𝟙 PG.pt - towerShift (F := DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionDiagram J I K) hPG)
      δY ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))))
    (hu₁ : Fan.IsLimit.lift hPK (fun _ ↦ 𝟙 K) ≫ productTowerMap (PF := PK) hPG
      (DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionCone J I K).π = u ≫ cY)
    (hu₃ : δK ≫ u⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = productTowerMap (PF := PK) hPG
      (DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionCone J I K).π ≫ δY) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.reductionModIdeal J I).map u)
